newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices down on speculative selling.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices down on speculative selling.

text.p: Castor prices fell on Monday on speculative selling and improved supplies, traders said.
Castorseed March delivery dropped to 1,158/1,159 rupees per quintal from 1,171/1,172 rupees, they said.
"Overseas buying remained low while rising new crop arrivals kept bull operators active sellers," a trader said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 341/343 rupees per 10 kg on limited arrivals of 40/50 tonnes, traders said. In Rajkot, spot oil was steady at 510/515 rupees per 15 kg.
In Bombay, imported palm-oil slid to 281/282 rupees per 10 kg from 285 rupees on fresh arrivals of about 3,000 tonnes.
